translations.web: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
translations.bsb: if you put away the iniquity in your hand, and allow no injustice to dwell in your tents,
translations.kjv: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
translations.asv: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, And let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents.
